title: Design: Bill Invoices To window shows its help line, field and buttons
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer.
  • Start on customer B's page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-13-after-change.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A small window opens with the title "Bill Invoices To" and an x at its top right.
  • Its grey help line reads "New work orders and part sales for [customer B's name] will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."
  • One full-width field labelled "Bill Invoices To" shows customer A's name with a down arrow.
  • A blue "Save" button sits at the bottom right (the design also draws a grey "Cancel" before it: see Difference).

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R2: “Users who may set the default see "Change" beside the name; it opens the "Bill Invoices To" window.”
  • S1-R3: “The window shows the help line "New work orders and part sales for [customer] will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
  • S1-R4: “The window has a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field and a "Save" button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Change" (This build).

  • “Window "Bill Invoices To": "New work orders and part sales for Buda Truck Repair will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
